page.intro: Connect an AI service with your own API key, choose a model for each job, add prices and set spending limits. Each part is saved on its own.
page.loadFailed: AI services couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
status.onDetail: The jobs your course needs have a working connection, a model, prices and spending limits.
issue.keyProblem: {count, plural, one {# connection has a key problem} other {# connections have a key problem}}
issue.models: {count, plural, one {# job needs a model} two {# jobs need a model} other {# jobs need a model}}
issue.check: {count, plural, one {# model is waiting for a quality check} two {# models are waiting for a quality check} other {# models are waiting for a quality check}}
issue.notOn: your model choices aren't turned on yet
issue.prices: {count, plural, one {# model needs a price} two {# models need a price} other {# models need a price}}
connect.title: Connect an AI service
connect.intro: Course Core uses your own API key. It is stored encrypted on this server and is never shown again.
connect.keyHelp.google: Create a key in Google AI Studio
connect.keyHelp.anthropic: Create a key in the Anthropic Console
connect.testOk: Key works. {service} offers {count, plural, one {# model} two {# models} other {# models}} to this key.
connect.nameHint: Helps you tell connections apart, for example “Google – school account”.
connect.errRejected: {service} rejected this key. Check that you copied the whole key, or create a new one.
connect.errForbidden: This key works but isn't allowed to use the {service} API. Turn the API on for the key's project, then try again.
connect.errQuota: {service} says this key has no remaining quota or billing isn't set up. Check billing in your {service} account.
connect.errUnreachable: This server couldn't reach {service}. Check its internet access or proxy settings, then try again.
connect.errRateLimited: Too many key checks in the last hour. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} two {# minutes} other {# minutes}}.
connect.errMalformed: This doesn't look like an API key. It contains spaces or characters a key can't have.
connect.errUnexpected: The key check didn't finish. Try again; nothing was saved.
connect.saveUntestedWarn: The key will be saved untested. AI help will fail until it works.
row.replaceNote: The new key replaces the old one for every model using this connection. Jobs already running finish with the old key.
row.removeBody: {name} and its key are deleted from this server. This can't be undone.
row.inUse: {jobs} use this connection. Choose other models for them first.
role.companion.name: Learner tutor
role.companion.purpose: Chats with learners about the lesson.
role.supervisor.name: Lesson planner
role.supervisor.purpose: Decides what each learner does next and when to review.
role.research.name: Source finder
role.research.purpose: Finds and summarises outside sources for staff to approve.
role.reviewer.name: Answer review drafts
role.reviewer.purpose: Drafts feedback on written answers for staff to review.
role.media.name: Images and video
role.media.purpose: Makes illustrations or short clips for staff to review.
models.intro: We picked a suggestion for each job your course uses. You can change them later.
models.basis: Suggestions are based on the model list your service reports. The quality check below tries them out.
models.optional: {count, plural, one {Optional job (#)} two {Optional jobs (#)} other {Optional jobs (#)}}
models.mayNotWork: May not work for this job
models.listFailed: The model list couldn't be loaded.
models.videoNote: Check these against the model's documentation.
models.savedWaiting: Models saved. {count, plural, one {# model needs} two {# models need} other {# models need}} a quality check before it turns on. See Quality check below.
models.pending: Your new choices are saved but not on yet. Learners still get the models that are on now.
models.errVideo: Fill in the video settings, or choose Image.
prices.intro: Course Core doesn't include {service}'s prices, because they change. Copy them from {service}'s pricing page.
prices.nothing: Prices appear here after you choose models.
prices.missingNote: Until you add prices, these jobs stay off.
prices.errBoth: Enter the input price, or leave both prices empty
prices.errSource: Say where the prices come from
spending.perLearnerHint: Applies to every learner who doesn't have their own limit.
spending.perRequestSummary: {amount} · up to {minutes, plural, one {# minute} two {# minutes} other {# minutes}}
spending.note: When a limit is reached, AI help pauses for that workspace or learner until you raise it. {service}'s own billing is separate.
spending.noteGeneric: When a limit is reached, AI help pauses for that workspace or learner until you raise it. Your AI service's own billing is separate.
spending.consent: Pressing the button records your consent to spend up to this amount on AI calls.
spending.errLearnerMore: The limit for each learner can't be more than the total
spending.errBelowUsage: This is less than what's already been used ({used}).
history.title: Spending so far
history.note: Course Core's own records, not an invoice. Periods are in UTC.
check.notChecked: {count, plural, one {This model hasn't been checked yet:} two {These models haven't been checked yet:} other {These models haven't been checked yet:}}
check.nothingWaiting: No model is waiting for a check.
check.explain: The quality check runs {dialogues, plural, one {# practice conversation} two {# practice conversations} other {# practice conversations}} with your models and checks that replies follow the teaching rules. It uses your key and budget.
check.notHere: Running the check from this page isn't available yet. A developer can run it from the command line and upload the result (see Advanced), or an owner can approve the models without checking.
check.approveOwnersOnly: Only an owner can approve without checking. Ask an owner, or run the check.
check.reasonLabel: Why are you skipping the check?
check.reasonHint: At least 20 characters. Saved in the audit log with your name.
check.errReason: Write at least 20 characters about why you're skipping the check.
check.disclaimer: The check is a set of rules, not proof of teaching quality.
check.state.not_covered: No check for this job yet — ready
confirm.title: Stop unfinished jobs?
confirm.body: Turning this on stops {count, plural, one {# unfinished job} two {# unfinished jobs} other {# unfinished jobs}}. Calls already sent may still finish and be charged.
advanced.intro: For developers and unusual setups. Changes here skip the guided checks above, but the server still enforces the quality check and spending limits.
advanced.configNote: Each connection stores its key in its own encrypted slot on the server (shown here as COURSE_PROVIDER_…_API_KEY). You never need to type this name. No key is ever part of this configuration.
advanced.roleIds: Job ids: companion (Learner tutor), supervisor (Lesson planner), research (Source finder), reviewer (Answer review drafts), media (Images and video). Setup version {revision}.
advanced.jsonWaiting: Configuration saved as a draft. It turns on after the quality check (see Quality check).
advanced.limitsInvalid: Enter whole numbers within the allowed range.
advanced.fallbackLabel: If the subscription {name} runs out, use an API key instead
advanced.youtubeHint: Lets staff search YouTube for course sources.
advanced.requirePricing: Refuse paid work for models without a price
advanced.requirePricingAck: I understand that without a price each call is charged at its full per-request limit.
advanced.historyEmpty: No quality-check results or approvals yet.
advanced.cli: Run the check from the command line with npm run eval:agents in services/api, then upload the report with POST …/provider-evals/results.
err.stale: Someone else changed AI services since you opened this page. Reload to see their changes; your choices in this section are kept.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission to change AI services. Ask a workspace owner.
err.unavailable: The server couldn't be reached. Your changes are still here. Try again.
err.generic: That didn't work. Try again; nothing was changed.
err.evalRequired: These models need a quality check or an owner's approval before they turn on.
err.connectionInUse: {jobs} use this connection. Choose other models for them first.
err.budgetBelowUsage: A limit can't be lower than what's already been used.
err.consent: Press the spending button to give consent.
err.tooSmall: The limit for each request is too small for these models. Raise it in Advanced.
err.modelUnavailable: That model isn't in the service's model list any more. Choose another one.
err.contextTooSmall: This model can't take enough text for the lesson planner. Choose a model with a larger input limit.
err.configInvalid: The configuration isn't valid. Check it and try again.
err.secretField: The configuration contains a field that looks like a key or password. Keys go in Connections, never in the configuration.
readonly.body: Only workspace owners and administrators can change AI services. Ask one of them if something needs to change.
readonly.demo: This is the demo. AI services are set up on a connected server.
